notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
Hey there, Designers! ✧

Guess what? Your highly-anticipated update for Party Maker is finally here! Get ready for an enhanced gameplay experience, a new addition called the Festival of Love, and a Creative Mode to ignite your imagination!

Here's the rundown:
Access Creative Mode right from your office in the upcoming update.
Launch any level without worrying about tasks, demands, or budget constraints (we've got you covered with 100k). 
Unlock new decorations as you progress in the story mode.
After completing the first ballroom task, a Side Jobs tab appears on your laptop. There's a new order waiting for you at a Japanese school where you'll organize the Festival of Love. ♡ 
But wait, there's more ♡ Unlock fresh decorations to jazz up your events.
We've also fixed reported bugs and more!

We're ecstatic to announce this update, hoping it makes up for the time you've spent waiting (〜^∇^)〜.

See you at Party Maker!

[previewyoutube=IeHsQn1-9U4;full][/previewyoutube]

BIG UPDATE | 新しいレベルとクリエイティブモード

こんにちは、デザイナーの皆さん！ ✧

何だと思いますか？ Party Makerの待望のアップデートがついにここに登場しました！ ゲームプレイの体験を向上させる準備をし、フェスティバル・オブ・ラブと呼ばれる新しい要素、そしてあなたの想像力をかき立てるためのクリエイティブモードに備えてください！

以下が概要です：
次のアップデートでは、オフィスから直接クリエイティブモードにアクセスできます。
タスク、要求、予算の心配なく、どんなレベルでも開始できます。 ストーリーモードで進むにつれて新しい装飾をアンロックしていきます。
最初のバルのタスクを完了したら、ラップトップに「サイドジョブ」タブが表示されます。あなたがラブフェスティバルを開催する日本の学校で新しい注文が待っています。 ♡
でも待って、それだけでない ♡ 新しいイベントに華を添えるために新しい装飾をアンロックしてください。
また、報告されたバグを修正しました！

このアップデートが、お待ちいただいた時間を埋め合わせできることを願っています (〜^∇^)〜。

Party Makerでお会いしましょう！

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125890/Party_Maker/

notes.title: Meet the Team
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35499197/1e94384c71b2c580ceb17babd6518f2841797717.jpg[/img]

[b]Dariusz Dywelski [/b]- the Chief Game Designer,  a mad scientist, an experienced event organizer. Darek came up with the main game concept and successfully implemented it. It was him who prepared so many surprises in the game, hidden interactions, and unexpected twists.

[b]Grzegorz Wilczyński [/b]- Secondary Game Designer, it was Grzegorz who came up with many surprising tasks for you. Grzegorz can also be heard in the game… yes, it’s him who earned some extra money as a voice actor.

[b]Marcin Sadomski [/b]- a world-famous generalist specialist. Marcin embraced everything related to environment. He has prepared such beautiful and varied levels for you. Hundreds, or maybe millions of details - rustling grass, falling leaves or a dragon dancing in the lake! It will all make your cleaning and dealing with orders more enjoyable!

[b]Damian Borek [/b]- an equally famous Specialist Programmer. It was Damian who made everything that Darek and Grzegorz invented and what Marcin and Oliwia created in a game working properly.

[b]Oliwia Głuszko [/b]- home decor and decoration specialist. It was Oliwia who came up with hundreds of embellishments for every occasion.

[b]Patrycja Kowalska[/b] - meddist, hypnotist, herbalist and specialist in 2D graphics. She prepared the UI graphics and the game logo.

[b]Darek Kowalski[/b] - coordinator for specialist tasks, that were mainly sweeping, vacuuming, garbage collection, general project coordination, testing, and tossing clever ideas.

[b]Tomek Mazur [/b]- the Boss, sometimes had an accurate remark, sometimes not very accurate, but everyone pretended that they were all accurate. However, without him it would have been difficult to complete this project.

We’d also like to express great gratitude for Invaluable help and support to: programmers - [b]Damian Zajda[/b] and [b]Mateusz Rapta[/b], 3D artists - [b]Rafał Malicki[/b], [b]Andrzej Orzechowski,[/b] music designers: [b]Lukas Bonzzi[/b] and [b]Jakub Madzia[/b], and many thanks to [b]Przemek Garczarek[/b] and [b]Bartosz Królikowski[/b] for their support. 

We would also like to thank all the testers, people who played the demo and the prologue of our game, providing us with extremely valuable feedback.

Cheers, :)

notes.title: The Art of Decorating
notes.content:
Hello Designers!

Did you know that functional home decor makes use of psychology? Have you ever noticed how a small room can sometimes look larger than it is? Or how a bigger space manages to appear cozy and comfortable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35499197/a0927d375c38fa049df026ab91c42d2ca953a6fb.jpg[/img]

It’s all thanks to the right decor tricks that make a space seem much different than it is, like the right use of light or the distance between most significant pieces of furniture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35499197/42bfa71bf2c6b6cbe22be4585b8a61a56f7f7920.jpg[/img]

In Party Maker, you’ll have an opportunity to experiment with all those decorating techniques and develop your own, unique style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35499197/2c29b2798c3d3f8d8faa9b500dd4727631bb3781.jpg[/img]

Stay in touch with us!
Forestlight Team

notes.title: Rebranding
notes.content:
[b]We’re thrilled to unveil the refreshed brand identity of Wedding Designer -> PARTY MAKER![/b]

The game development has gone a long way since the 2019 Wedding Designer trailer. While rebranding is a significant change, our philosophy, as well as the core of the game remain the same.

[previewyoutube=qaKfambrWv8;full][/previewyoutube]

However, we really wanted to give you more than just weddings. The events will be more diverse, the first one taking place on the surface of planet Mars!

Over the last few months, we have poured our hearts into creating a new image that would accurately depict the new face of the Wedding Designer, which is the Party Maker.

We created a lot of new decorations, side activities, improved the interface and optimization. So you can expect new levels, decorations, and content even after the game release.
Trust us, we have tons of ideas.

A refreshed free version of Party Maker Farm Fest is also available. After that, in near future, we plan to release the game in early access. However, you don't have to worry that there will be nothing to do in the game. Remember, that we always take your opinion into account. If you use social media, please connect with us on Facebook, Twitter, Discord, or TikTok. As always, please do not hesitate to contact us anytime.

Regards,
Party Maker Team

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - new demo
notes.content:
Hey Designers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35499197/28d935309142aa9bf22182e97d6e206af5f1cde8.jpg[/img]

For the last couple of weeks, we’ve been working non-stop on the full release version of Wedding Designer. Most of the levels and decorations are almost finished; however, the most important feature is the new “Demands” mechanic. You’ll be able to see it in action in our new demo, which will be released on Steam Next Fest between 1-7.10. To make a long story short, our principals will have demands for certain decorations from now on. For example, you'll get bonuses if you deploy something blue when the customer asks for blue decorations. Simple stuff. But you don’t have to worry: this system won’t affect your creativity. Freedom of play is still the most important thing to us.

In the upcoming demo, you’ll visit an island with a Chinese garden, wherein our level artists did a fantastic job in creating a stunning environment for you to explore. Another cool thing we’ve added are lanterns, which can be hung to create a unique atmosphere at your weddings.

With regards to the previous chapel demo: if we were to write about the changes implemented, we’d have to write a small book. Therefore, we’ll just refer to the changes that we made to the prologue that was released some time ago:

- Demands system
- Each material will be marked on the minimap
- New radio with the option to change music.
- 6 brand new music tracks
- Possibility to hang lanterns
- New decorations
- Less disruptive walking and jumping sounds
- Refreshed menu layout
- Removal of the pump
- New red drapery

[previewyoutube=NGoWh_p3MCA;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for tuning in with us this week - see you next time!

Kind regards,
Wedding Designer Team

notes.title: Summary #01.2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35499197/672210871f3294c869deb24ebe200619819432d6.gif[/img]

[b]Features: [/b]

- Store management 
- Mowing the grass
- Outliner
- Language support
- Order and mail management
- Painting walls
- Item manager connected to inventory
- Wall decorations, ceiling decorations, rotation according to the selected axis
- Level manager with Scriptable objects
- Skill levels

[b]Optimization: [/b]

- Minimap
- Hints refactoring
- Item icons convert to textur2d
- Postprocessing update
- Lightmap baking method update
- 3D models on first level optimizations
- Trees, grass and plants better performance
- New collider system for decorations

[b]Bug fixes: [/b]

notes.title: DevLog#1 - Decorations
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=_PuIzmPeoDA;full][/previewyoutube]

We begin the implementation of our New Year's resolution - from now on we will keep you updated on our activities! Don't hesitate to share with us your ideas and comments!

We have already done a lot of work, which you will shortly see yourselves! 

This month, we are polishing all the variety of different decorations. Until now, our activities took place only in one location, but we are already creating new amazing spots, full of spectacular challenges. 

Young couples who employ us to organize their dream wedding have more and more extraordinary ideas in their minds and they're choosing some really bizarre locations.

We've added extended decorating mechanics and several new types of them. 
E.g. Benches, chairs, doors, suspended from the ceiling, hanging on the wall, or free-standing.
You can buy decorations in the store or create them yourself from found items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35499197/17e0aa83a8c5ffd2354a61c029db68cb59a1bb8a.gif[/img]

At the current, early stage of production Wedding Designer you can explore first location - abandoned chapel. Cleaning, rearranging furniture and other objects, washing walls, we have everything ready.

Don't worry... We'll make it work!

See you next time!
